name: USS Nimitz Encounter
description: Multiple F/A-18 pilots encountered unidentified object off San Diego coast. Tracked on multiple radar systems. Video footage (FLIR1) later declassified by DoD.

witnesses.desc: Initial radar contact — USS Princeton SPY-1 radar
Commander Fravor visual — Tic Tac shape, no wings
Object descends from 80,000ft to sea level in seconds
Object disappears — reappears 60 miles away instantaneously

notes: SPY-1 radar tracked object for 2 weeks before intercept
Object showed no IR exhaust signature
Instantaneous relocation 60 miles — no ballistic trajectory
USS Princeton fire control radar jammed during intercept
ATFLIR footage shows no heat signature from propulsion
